problem: The previous structural validator required a nonempty spec-meta documentId but did not compare it with the source-derived bound document definition. A correct outer DRAFT response documentId/path could carry a different metadata documentId inside its unchanged Markdown; that body could then pass structural validation and receive an accepted AI approval.
generality: Applies to any source-derived document ID or kind; no business names, field values, fixed expected IDs, or evaluator answers are embedded in production code.

repair.behavior: When a bound identity is supplied, compare the real metadata documentId exactly and emit ERROR META_DOCUMENT_ID at the metadata line on mismatch.
repair.compatibility: Standalone two-argument callers and explicit None preserve the existing validation behavior; the validator never rewrites Markdown.
repair.workflow: Both workflow.document and workflow.review supply definition['id']; existing ReviewStructureConflict prevents AI approval from overriding the detected defect.
repair.aiAuthorship: AI continues to author analysis, prose, facts and revisions. Python validates identity correspondence and preserves artifacts only.

validation.meaningfulNegative: Synthetic bound CART draft with correct outer CART identity/path but Markdown metadata OTHER is retained as STRUCTURE_INVALID; an independent approving AI review is rejected and no review-verified.json is written.
directCoverage: Wrong metadata ID with correct path
Expected ID present only in body or fenced example

scope: No evaluator expectations, original project specifications, or business-specific source were inputs to this generic change.
